review.light: User selected option 2. Full-body light armor, intact single figure, water rings and green lily-pad profile.
review.casual1: Covered rainy porch, kneeling pose, dark technical-knit top and ivory shorts. The companion is an original small amphibian. Reference headpiece remains visible as an accessory.
review.casual2: Sunlit ranch with wood rafters and straw, dark teal ring-front one-piece and straw hat. Single figure confirmed despite the landmark model detecting a second pose proposal.
review.casual3: Glass-walled office at dusk, baker peplum and apron, and the square portrait. Both forearms connect through their elbows to the shoulders.
review.casual4: Roadside stall with a berry pitcher, performance outerwear and a partial front opening. Pouring and supporting arms are both continuous.
review.casual5: Lace veil and bodice at the esports stage. The closest hand is attached to the forearm leading to the visible elbow and shoulder. The second arm is cropped at the shoulder; the close crop confuses the landmark detector.
review.casual6: Twilight amusement-park stalls, custom cosplay neckline with recognizable color blocking, and a forward-reaching wink. The gown hem is outside the planned crop.
review.casual7: Harbor ferry deck at night, blue leaf-trim event costume and lily-pad headpiece. Face keeps the selected green eyes and swept layered blue-green hair.
review.casual8: Backstage vanity and costume rails, blue embroidered sari-blouse-inspired set, full figure in a landscape composition.
review.casual9: Golden-hour tidal boardwalk, lifted listening horn, bronze pleated vest and a stepped mulberry skirt. The hands swap their planned sides while performing the two intended actions. The overlay wrist falls onto the background while the rail hand and its forearm are visibly continuous in the original.
review.casual10: A public sound archive with headphones, lavender tailored romper and cool overhead light. The relaxed hand rests on the thigh and the other lightly holds the earcup. The raised upper arm projects toward the viewer, explaining the shortened landmark span. Original and overlay both show continuous limbs.
review.casual90: Indoor pool lifeguard scene. She sits sideways on the chair and checks the kickboard with both hands. Whistle, sports swimsuit and short wrap are visible.
